items.section: 1.1 A living self, and the restoration it makes
items.sentence: Attentioning is not a clock and not an external counter — it is a survival of a fittest within a carry, a sorting each beat that ages one not sharing outward past a bound and re-finds one sharing fresh within it
items.text: A reading over 353 CpG positions, 193 of them rising and 160 falling with age, across 7,844 non-cancer samples of 82 datasets and 51 tissues and cell types, stands at a median absolute error of 3.6 years and a correlation of 0.96 with chronological age. Induced pluripotent stem cells read near zero whatever a donor's chronological age, and embryonic stem cells read near zero. Across cancer samples the reading stands a mean 36.2 years above chronological age, and its correlation with chronological age stands at 0.15.
items.from: A methylation reading over 353 positions, its error, and its zero at reprogrammed cells

leaving.from: Three purified proteins with ATP, a 24-hour cycle for at least 10 days
leaving.why: held at gathering-value Natural Biology 4.5: "a cyanobacterial clock rebuilt in a test tube from the three proteins KaiA, KaiB and KaiC alone sustains a 22-hour rhythm over several days once ATP is added". Two figures part, 22 hours against about 24 and several days against at least 10, and a reachable primary gives neither: the about-24 stands at a review and not at a primary, and a temperature compensating of the period over 25 to 35 degrees, a tenth of the period, stands with neither entry. Natural Biology's gathering-value is away with two open pull requests, so the parting and the compensating go to them and not here

leaving.from: Discrimination by a binding energy alone and an irreversible step beneath its floor
leaving.why: a field's explaining, its ground and its mechanism. Its two figures, a discriminating by a binding energy alone at about 3kT with DNA base pairing and an error rate far below 10⁻⁷ with a chromosome of 10⁷ bases, stand at no living file: kT stands only as Landauer's kT ln 2, and Natural Biology 4.7 holds measured rates of another shape, about one in a hundred thousand to about one in a billion across tiers. They aim at Natural Biology 4.7 as a field's explaining and not as an observing, and that file is away with two open pull requests, so they go to them. The irreversible step's own improving factor and its cost stand with no number here
